I can help you with various document editing tasks. Here are some things you can ask me to do:

1. Format text (bold, italic, underline, font size, etc.)
2. Insert content (text, tables, images)
3. Perform document operations (select all, copy, paste)
4. Apply paragraph formatting (alignment, spacing)
5. Work with tables (insert, merge cells, format)

Just tell me what you'd like to do, and I'll provide the appropriate commands or guidance.
